newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nomura, brokerages fall on renewed selling.
newsitem.headline: Nomura, brokerages fall on renewed selling.

text.p: Shares in Nomura Securities Co Ltd and other issues in the securities sector fell in Monday's afternoon session, hit by renewed selling, brokers said.

"There don't seem to be any new factors to prompt the selling, but on the other hand there are no factors to encourage buying either," a "Big Four" broker said. "The weakness in the sector is a sign that market sentiment is not very good."
As of 0436 GMT, Nomura was down 30 yen at 1,350, a low for the year. It was the second most heavily traded issue on the Tokyo bourse with volume totalling 5.97 million shares.
Daiwa Securities Co Ltd fell 29 yen to 880 while Nikko Securities Co Ltd shed 11 yen to 700.
